claim: On 2024-5-16 the Amazon MSK guide added the broker removal feature: you can reduce your provisioned cluster's storage and compute capacity by removing sets of brokers, with no availability impact, data durability risk, or disruption to your data streaming applications.
question: Since when can you remove brokers from an Amazon MSK provisioned cluster?
note: Older exam questions may say a provisioned cluster can only grow in brokers.
